title: The Lamplighter
text: A lamplighter in the Faceless City goes from post to post with his long pole, lighting lamps that burn a cold green. Under them, every passer-by shows their true face, just for a heartbeat. Some of them scream when they see it.

options.label: Each Scion walks under the green lamps.

outcomes.text: Their own face, a little older, a little sadder.

options.label: Each Scion keeps to the dark between the lamps.

outcomes.text: The faces in the dark are worse.
